title: Secure Data Intelligence Platform
summary: A portfolio-scale system that ingests business events, protects them, transforms them into governed analytics, detects risk, and delivers explainable ML insights. Build it in small milestones while completing the aligned projects in every track.
principles: Use only synthetic or authorized data.
Keep secrets out of source code.
Treat Ethical Hacking work as sandbox-only and written-scope-only.
Document evidence, tests, limitations, and decisions at every stage.

phases.outcome: A Python command-line application creates and validates synthetic business events.

tracks.projects: Starter build, experiment, bug fix, validation, tests, documentation
tracks.deliverable: Validated JSON/CSV event generator with unit tests.

tracks.projects: Asset inventory, data classification, basic access policy
tracks.deliverable: Threat model and security checklist for the local application.

phases.outcome: Synthetic events are loaded, modelled, and governed for analytics.

tracks.projects: SQL model, stage/load design, RBAC, masking, cost checks
tracks.deliverable: Governed analytics schema and load runbook.
Repeatable ingestion helper and audit log.

phases.outcome: Raw events become trusted tables through incremental transformations.

tracks.projects: PySpark transformation, Delta tables, workflow, quality checks
tracks.deliverable: Bronze-to-silver-to-gold pipeline with tests and observability notes.
Incremental refresh design and reconciliation checklist.

phases.outcome: The platform produces useful logs, access evidence, and incident-ready procedures.

tracks.projects: Log analysis, IAM review, firewall policy, incident runbook
tracks.deliverable: Detection rules, access-review evidence, and a tabletop incident report.

tracks.projects: Scope, sandbox review, secure-code review, remediation roadmap
tracks.deliverable: Authorized sandbox assessment report with remediation priorities.

phases.outcome: A model identifies a safe, explainable business or risk pattern from synthetic data.

tracks.projects: EDA, baseline model, evaluation, monitoring plan, model card
tracks.deliverable: Reproducible model notebook/project with metrics and limitations.

tracks.projects: MLflow-style experiment tracking and feature pipeline
tracks.deliverable: Versioned experiment record and deployment readiness checklist.

phases.outcome: A complete demonstration with architecture, safety controls, tests, results, and lessons learned.

tracks.deliverable: Architecture diagram, README, setup guide, test evidence, security review, model evaluation, and a short demo script.
